author: Brent Rossow
releaseNotes: Catches every detection on a busy station: each poll now reads all detections since the last one, not just the newest 10, so first-of-day and first-ever species are no longer missed when birds arrive faster than the poll interval, after night mode, or after hub downtime. After a long gap birdDetected fires for the 10 newest only. For private stations the API token now goes in the URL in place of the station ID, which is where BirdWeather reads station tokens; it was sent in a header BirdWeather only reads for administrator tokens. Fixed a poll error when no recent detection met Minimum Confidence, a burst of repeat events after raising Minimum Confidence, and retries that could switch off for good after saving preferences. Station IDs with stray spaces or pasted as a link now work. Added healthStatus (online or offline).
